decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a high-quality portable speaker with strong bass and durability for outdoor and garage use. My consideration set includes top-tier options from Sony, Bose, and JBL, as well as well-reviewed alternatives like EDUPLINK and TENMIYA. The Sony SRS-XB43 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_181) is my final choice because of its IP67 rating, excellent reputation for bass output (Extra Bass line), and positive feedback regarding its 24-hour battery life. While the Bose is a solid compact choice and the JBL offers good value as a renewed item, the Sony provides the power and ruggedness I need for larger spaces.
